name: hometv-webos
description: HomeTV on LG webOS: research spike and the first TV call's checks app.

scripts.build:app: tsc --noEmit -p app && vite build && node tools/page-build.mjs && node tools/check-legacy.mjs
scripts.package: node tools/build.mjs && npx -y -p @webos-tools/cli@3.2.6 ares-package dist/checks-app checks/service -o dist
